lines.japanese: ──よし、適当に流そう。面白そうなやつだけど、逆に情が湧いたら厄介だ。
lines.english: —All right. Brush it off. She looked interesting, which would only make things worse if I grew attached.

lines.japanese: 「あージンクピリチオンね。なにそれ、俺が知らねーと思ってんじゃねーぞ。てめ、ジンクピリチオンくらい知ってんだよコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Ahh, zinc pyrithione. What? You think I don't know what that is? I know zinc pyrithione, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 俺はことさら語気を荒げ、ちんぴらヤクザのように言った。
lines.english: I made my voice deliberately vicious and spoke like some two-bit gangster.

lines.japanese: 「えっ……？　あ、えっと、アいえあの、知ってるとか知らないとか、あの、そういうあれじゃなくてはい」
lines.english: “What...? Oh, um, n-no, I didn't mean whether you knew or didn't know, that wasn't what I—yes.”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: ガキがビクついてるのは分かったが、俺はあえて心を鬼にした。最後まで面倒を見てやれない野良猫に、一時の偽善で餌を与えるような無責任を俺は優しさと呼ばない。
lines.english: I knew the kid was frightened, but I hardened my heart. Feeding a stray cat once just to feel virtuous, when you couldn't look after it for life, was irresponsible. I refused to call that kindness.

lines.japanese: 「あっ……こういうの嫌い。俺スゲー嫌い。自分の知ってっこと、当たり前に人が知ってっと思ってるやつとかマジ嫌い。ふざけんなよテメ、ジンクピリチオンがなんだってんだよコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Ah... I hate this. Really hate it. I seriously hate people who assume everybody else knows whatever they happen to know. Don't fuck with me. What the hell is so special about zinc pyrithione, asshole?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はいあの、ジンクピリチオンっていうのは、そのピリチオン亜鉛──えと、だからその、要するに化学物質のことなんですけど、あの、なんていうかこれはつまり……」
lines.english: “Oh, yes, um, zinc pyrithione is pyrithione zinc—that is, it's a chemical substance, but, um, how should I put this? Essentially...”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、おまえ説明しちゃった。いや、もちろん俺知ってたけどねジンクピリチオン。でもおまえが説明したせいで、俺あたかもジンクピリチオン知らないやつみたいじゃん。何コレ、どうしてくれんのコレ」
lines.english: “Ah, you explained it. Obviously I already knew what zinc pyrithione was, but now that you've explained it, you've made me look like some guy who didn't. What's this? What are you going to do about this?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、すま、すまぃせん」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sor—sorree.”

lines.japanese: 「すまぃせんじゃないっつうの。噛んでんじゃねえよ。マジ俺アレだから。本当アレおまえ、マジでアレ」
lines.english: “Don't ‘sorree’ me. Quit tripping over your words. Seriously, I'm that thing. I really am—look, that thing. Seriously.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、いいや。そゆことだから。だからさっきの件、アレやっぱナシってことで悪りぃけど」
lines.english: “Whatever. So that's that. Sorry, but the thing we discussed before is off after all.”

lines.japanese: びしっ。
lines.english: *Snap.*

lines.japanese: やばい、俺ここまでの話のまとめ方、完璧じゃね。
lines.english: Damn. Hadn't I just tied the entire conversation together perfectly?

lines.japanese: はい、めでたしめでたし。さようなら小娘。そして俺は、中断していた清掃作業を再開しようとした。
lines.english: And they all lived happily ever after. Farewell, little girl. I turned to resume the cleaning I had interrupted.

lines.japanese: 「待ちなドラ。あんたね、今時分、任侠モンでもそんな話の進め方ァしやせんよ？」
lines.english: “Hold it, Dora. Even yakuza movies don’t railroad people like that anymore.”

lines.japanese: と思ったら俺の巧みな話術を全否定された。ああくそ、せっかく相手は納得してんのに。
lines.english: And there went the total rejection of my masterful rhetoric. Goddammit. The other party had accepted it and everything.

lines.japanese: 「小っこいねーちゃん、あんたも流されちゃダメだってんだ、ええッ。どうせこいつの言ってることなんざ大方間違ってんだからよォ」
lines.english: “And you, little miss, don't just let him sweep you along. Most everything this boy says is wrong to begin with.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ！？　んだと、上等だクレープ屋。そんな言うなら、じゃあ今から間違いだらけばっか言ってやッからよ。てめ、吐いたツバ飲まんとけよコラよーいスタート」
lines.english: “What!? Fine, crêpe lady. If that’s what you’re saying, I’ll start getting everything wrong on purpose. Don’t you dare take back what you said, asshole. Ready, set, go!”

lines.japanese: 「うおっ、なんだこのピンクの美女。すっげー、ここの店主イケてんわ。はんぱねーわ。も店主っつーか、むしろ天使じゃん。やべ、なんか俺ン中降りてきたわ。賛美歌的なモンが聞こえてきたわ」
lines.english: “Whoa, who’s this gorgeous vision in pink? Damn, the woman running this place is hot. Unbelievable. Forget shopkeeper—she’s an angel. Oh, man, something holy is descending into me. I can hear a hymn.”

lines.japanese: 「無職はムリだわー、どんなに若くても無職はムリだわー。そんだけ誉められても無職じゃ揺れんわー」
lines.english: “Unemployed is a dealbreaker. However young he is, unemployed is a dealbreaker. All that flattery still can't move me while he's unemployed.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、成田隼人がウソしか言わねッて言いだしたのあんたなんだけど。なんでさりげなく趣旨が変わって、いつの間にかパル姐さんを誉める会みたいな空気になってんの」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa. You're the one who said Hayato Narita does nothing but lie. How did the purpose quietly change until this became a meeting of the Paru Appreciation Society?”

lines.japanese: 「無職はムリだわー、どんなに高くても無職はムリだわー」
lines.english: “Unemployed is a dealbreaker. However tall he is, unemployed is a dealbreaker.”

lines.japanese: 「てめ、話聞けっつってんだろ。マジ泣くぞ。ガチで泣くぞ。いい年こいて本イキでわんわん泣くぞ。あとから泣いて止められたって、泣く子は黙んねーかンなコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Listen when I’m talking. I’ll cry, I mean it. A grown man my age will bawl his eyes out in deadly earnest. You can cry and beg me to stop later, but once this big baby starts bawling, he doesn’t shut up, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのう……すみません、自転車の件はもう結構ですから。ほんと、お騒がせして申しわけありません」
lines.english: “Um... I'm sorry, but please forget about the bicycle. Truly, I apologize for causing all this trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「かーッ！　偉いねえ、悪くもないのに頭下げちまって、ええッ？　あんたの方が、そこのドラ猫よかよっぽど大人だコンチクショー！」
lines.english: “Would you look at that! Bowing her head when she hasn't done a thing wrong. Huh? She's twice the adult that mangy alley cat Dora is, goddammit!”

lines.japanese: 「おーおー、おばちゃん、横からしゃしゃって人のアイデン的なものブチ壊すのとかやめてくんない。むしろ俺の立ち位置まで崩れおちそうなんですけど」
lines.english: “Hey, lady, could you quit barging in from the side and destroying my identi-whatever? My whole position in this conversation is crumbling with it.”

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってやんでいベラボウめぇ！　ドラ、あんたの立ち位置は、ハナっからこの子の自転車探すとこなんだよ。覚悟しとけってんだ馬鹿野郎がァ」
lines.english: “What nonsense are you talking, you fool! Dora, your position from the start was finding this girl's bicycle. Accept your fate, idiot!”

lines.japanese: 「あー、もー……」
lines.english: “Ahh, come on...”

lines.japanese: 俺は適当に済ますはずだった話がどんどんめんどくさくなってきたので、後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: The conversation I had meant to brush aside was growing more troublesome by the second, so I scratched furiously at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「つか再度ぶっちゃけるけど、悪りぃ、ほんと無理だわチャリ探しとか。そんなん砂漠の中から一粒の砂探すようなもんだもん」
lines.english: “Look, I'll level with you one more time. Sorry, but finding a bike is seriously impossible. It'd be like searching the whole desert for one grain of sand.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、砂漠で砂を探すのは簡単だろ」
lines.english: “Finding sand in a desert would be easy.”

lines.japanese: 「てめ、挙げ足とってンじゃねーよ。そういう砂じゃねンだよ。砂漠の中にあるたった一粒の、なんつーか光りかがやく砂なんだよ。そこらのケツの穴拭く砂とは存在そのものが違げーんだよ」
lines.english: “Quit picking apart the wording. I don’t mean that kind of sand. I mean one single, I don’t know, shining grain in the entire desert. It’s on a whole different plane of existence from the ordinary sand you wipe your ass with.”

lines.japanese: 「したら、光りかがやいてる時点でソレもう砂じゃないだろ」
lines.english: “If it's shining, then by that point it isn't sand.”

lines.japanese: 「だから挙げ足とるなッつってんだよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I told you to quit picking apart the wording. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あイエ、はい、おっしゃりたいことは伝わりましたので。ええ、大丈夫です、どんまいです」
lines.english: “Oh—no, yes. I understood what you meant. It’s all right. Don’t let it get you down.”

lines.japanese: 「おお悪りぃね、俺はほら、ケツの穴を拭くほうの砂だから。んじゃ」
lines.english: “Yeah, sorry. See, I'm the kind of sand you wipe your ass with. Bye.”

lines.japanese: 俺が女二人に背を向けてひらひら手を振ると、後ろからはこれ見よがしに嘆息の音がひとつ聞こえた。
lines.english: I turned my back on the two women and gave a lazy wave. Behind me, someone heaved an ostentatious sigh.

lines.japanese: 関係ないやと思った。
lines.english: Nothing to do with me, I decided.
